provenance.scope: Complete no-growth allocate/bind/resolve/release/mode2/mark/reassign routines. Owner initialization executes only genuine post-allocation success tail00461E04..00461E9B on supplied slot buffers. Three failing reassign calls stop at first00439230 diagnostic entry before executing it; these are mutation-frontier receipts, not completed calls.
provenance.excluded: Full owner allocation, table growth/reallocation, fatal reporting, actor construction/destruction, network cursor processing and owning object lifetime.

initialization_tail.registers: EBX=owner header; ESI=header+14; EDI=capacity; [header+14]=supplied writable slot buffer.
initialization_tail.stack: saved EDI, saved ESI, saved EBX, header, return address, owner index; same six DWORD positions as original post-allocation prologue.
initialization_tail.guards: A5 slot allocation prefix/suffix checked after every snapshot; native writes all logical slot fields.

normalization.object: Synthetic pointer payload normalized to an integer ID. No actor or common-object constructor runs.
normalization.object_handles: Only explicitly seeded caller words and real reassign writes at payload+84 are tracked; allocate does not write this actor field.
normalization.seed: Explicit synthetic table/cache/caller prior state, never claimed as native-produced.
normalization.void_returns: Bind/release/mark return registers are not interpreted as booleans; only actual state/output-word effects are recorded.
